sahelanthropus-tchadensis.description: A hairy, ape-like creature with a dark face and brown fur stands upright on muddy ground at the edge of a calm, reflective lake at dusk, with dark trees and reeds around it. The painting is loose, oil-like, and fills the whole frame. No text, buildings, or tools are visible.

orrorin-tugenensis.description: A dark-furred, ape-like primate with a bare face walks on two legs along a thick mossy branch in a dense, dim forest. One arm reaches up to grip a bough overhead, the other hangs at its side. Shafts of light and hanging vines fill the background. The painting is an oil-style texture with no visible text, frame or era-specific objects.

ardipithecus-ramidus-appears.description: A dark-furred, chimp-faced ape-like hominin with long arms walks upright on two legs through a dense, dim forest. Buttress roots, vines, ferns and leaf litter surround it, and its foot is splayed with a grasping big toe. The painting fills the frame edge to edge with no text, border or signature, and nothing graphic.

australopithecus-anamensis-appears.description: A dark-furred, upright-walking ape-like figure wades through shallow, rippling dark water at the edge of a dense, misty forest. Hanging vines and tangled trees fill the background, with a dim, overcast sky and a grey lake stretching to the left. The painting is edge to edge with no text, frame or border.

laetoli-footprints.description: Two dark, bare-bodied upright figures seen from behind stand on a grey plain, backlit by a bright glow. A trail of footprints in wet grey ash runs from them toward the bottom edge of the frame. A dark volcano with a smoke plume sits in the background under a heavy stormy sky. Painterly, monochrome style, edge to edge with no frame or text.

australopithecus-africanus-appears.description: An oil-style painting of an upright, ape-like hominin with a long torso and a brown, hairy body, walking across rocky ground with a small juvenile clinging to its side. A second dark, ape-like figure stands in the background behind it. The setting is dry scrub with thorny branches, dark broken rocks and dry grass under a dim, warm light. No text, border or frame is visible, and there are no tools or modern objects.

oldowan-stone-tools.description: A painting in a dark, oil-paint style shows two weathered, sinewy hands. The upper-left hand grips a stone hammer striking a rounded cobble that rests on a flat rock. Sparks fly at the point of impact. Scattered flakes of grey stone and a broken animal bone lie in the dirt. The background is near-black, and there is no visible text, frame or border.

paranthropus-boisei-appears.description: A heavily built, dark-skinned hominin with a ridge along the top of its head and a massive jaw sits at the edge of murky water, grasping a fistful of grass and chewing the stems. Dense dark foliage and reeds fill the background, with a pool or marsh to the right. The painting is an oil-style image that runs edge to edge with no visible frame, border or text.

dmanisi-humans-leave-africa.description: Four or five early hominins with heavy brows and robust, bare-skinned builds walk single file along a rocky ridge. One carries a stone and another a leafy bundle; a staff-like stick is visible behind. Below lies a forest and a winding pale river through a valley, with hazy mountains and a dramatic cloudy sky. Oil-painting style, filling the frame edge to edge. No visible text, border or frame.
